summary: blockinfile supports unsafe_writes as a non-atomic fallback and validate to test the temp file with a %s command before replacing the target.
questions: How do I validate sshd_config before blockinfile writes it?
Can I use pipes in a blockinfile validate command?
What does unsafe_writes do in blockinfile?

answer_card.title: blockinfile validate and unsafe_writes
answer_card.answer_md:
- `validate`: command checked against a temp file via `%s` (required placeholder); no shell features
- `unsafe_writes` (false): allow non-atomic fallback (e.g. docker mounts); risk of corruption
